The live def walk (the file-patch site block, no census marker) cross-checks every promoted def against the stat grid, the planes, the xpValue formula and the registry census 478 -> 491.

The capture is the Curtiss PDF upload (pp. 8-12, the full A section, clean text) cross-checked against the archive.org dual scans. The pin-time walk finds TEN entries where the opener structural walk saw seven candidates: aboleth, afanc, agathion, annis, ant lion, ascomoid, aspis, atomie, aurumvorax, azer.
